DOP: brahma(n) n., m., and brahma, mfn. 1. ( n. ) [ S. brahman], ( i ) a Vedic text, a sacred formula; Abh 812 (~aṃ vede tapasi vuccate); Sp 111, 12 (~aṃ aṇatī ti brāhmaṇo mante sajjhāyatī ti attho) = Sv 244, 10 ; It-a II 141, 15 (bāhitapāpattā ~assa ca aṇanato brāhmaṇo); — ( ii ) a pure, excellent life or practice; Sv 865, 20 (dhammo hi seṭṭhaṭṭhena ~ā ti vuccati); Ud-a 97, 8 foll. (yaṃ tumhe seṭṭhaṭṭhena ~aṃ adhisīlādipaṭipattidhammaṃ sandiṭṭhaṃ caratha taṃ so tumhehi samānaṃ ~aṃ acarī ti sabrahmacārī); It-a I 176, 5 foll. (~aṃ seṭṭhaṃ caratī ti brahmacārī, ~ā vā seṭṭho ācāro etassa atthī ti brahmacārī); — 2. ( m. ) [ S. brahman] ( sg. nom. brahmā; acc. brahmānaṃ, brahmaṃ; instr. brahmunā, brahmanā; gen. brahmuno; loc. brahmani; voc. brahme; pl. nom. brahmāno, brahmā; acc. brahmāno, brahme; instr. brahmehi; gen. brahmānaṃ, brahmūnaṃ; see also Sadd 157, 21 foll. ), Abh 812 (pitāmahe jine seṭṭhe brāhmaṇe ca pitūsvapi ~ā vutto); Bv-a 11, 17 foll. (ayaṃ pana brahmasaddo mahābrahmabrāhmaṇatathāgatamātāpituseṭṭhādisu dissati); — ( i ) the god Brahmā; Vin I 5, 18 (atha kho ~ā Sahampati … brahmaloke antarahito bhagavato purato pāturahosi); 6, 6 (mayhaṃ kho ~e etad ahosi); 7, 3 (~ānaṃ Sahampatiṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi); D I 18, 6 (yo so satto paṭhamaṃ upapanno tassa evaṃ hoti ahaṃ asmi ~ā mahābrahmā abhibhū anabhibhūto … pitā bhūtabhavyānaṃ); II 209, 21* (~uno h’ etaṃ nimittaṃ obhāso vipulo mahā); 239, 7 foll. (na kho panāhaṃ ~ānaṃ passāmi na ~unā sākacchemi); III 30, 15 (yena mayaṃ bhotā ~unā nimmitā so nicco dhuvo sassato …); 81, 13 (brāhmaṇā va ~uno puttā orasā mukhato jātā brahmajā brahmanimittā brahmadāyādā); M I 2, 11 foll. (~aṃ ~ato sañjānāti … ~aṃ maññati ~ani maññati); 338, 8* (yo ~ānaṃ paripucchati, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be ~aṃ); A III 202, 11 (yo taṃ ~ānaṃ passati idaṃ dassanānaṃ aggaṃ); Sn 1024 (ko nu devo vā ~ā vā Indo vā pi Sujampati); Th 245 (yathā ~ā tathā eko; Th-a II 98, 28 : yathā ~ā ekeko cittapakoparahito jhānasukhena niccam eva sukhito viharati tathā); Ja VI 201, 13´ (~ā kira brāhmaṇādayo cattāro vaṇṇe nimminitvā); 207, 18* (aggissa ~ā paricāriko ti); 568, 8* (Indo ca ~ā ca Pajāpatī ca); Paṭis II 209, 15 (dibbena cakkhunā tassa ~uno rūpaṃ passati); Ap 540, 19 (devā nāgāsurā ~ā); Peṭ 34, 10 (Māro vā Indo vā ~ā vā tathāgato vā cakkavattī vā so vata nāma mātugāmo bhavissatī ti n’ etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati); Mil 75, 32 (bhagavā brahmacārī ti, tena hi bhante Nāgasena buddho ~uno sisso ti); Vism 593, 11 (nāmarūpamattato uddhaṃ añño satto vā puggalo vā devo vā ~ā vā natthī ti); Ps I 258, 9 (cattāro pi mahārājāno Sakko ca devānam indo ~ā ca Sahampati upaṭṭhānaṃ agamaṃsu); Spk I 351, 26 (ayaṃ vo ~ā sahatthā yaññaṃ paṭiggahetuṃ āgacchatī ti); Pv-a 98, 1 (~unā cintitaṃ, Be, Ce, Ee ~anā); Bv-a 11, 17 (brūhito tehi tehi guṇavisesehī ti ~ā); Mhv 31:78 (~ā chattaṃ adhāresi); — ifc see mahābrahmā ( sv maha[t] ); — ( ii ) a brahmā god, an inhabitant of the higher heavens; D I 251, 9 (ayaṃ pi kho … ~ānaṃ sahavyatāya maggo); M I 326, 8 (Bakassa ~uno evarūpaṃ pāpakaṃ diṭṭhigataṃ uppannaṃ hoti idaṃ niccaṃ idaṃ dhuvaṃ …); Th 1199 (tassa ~ā viyākāsi pañhaṃ puṭṭho); Ja V 115, 9´ (pitaro ti ~āno, devā ti upapattidevavasena chakāmāvacarā devā, so read with Be, Ce, Se ); VI 220, 25´ (Nārado nāma ~ā hutvā); Mil 13, 11 (~āno apphoṭesuṃ); Ee ~unaṃ pi); Ap-a 494, 8 (~ehi ca asurehi ca devehi ca accito); — ifc see pacceka-; — ( iii ) a most excellent person; a spiritually superior person ( like Brahmā, often the Buddha); A I 132, 12* (~ā ti mātāpitaro pubbācariyā ti vuccare; Mp II 204, 3 foll. ) = Ja V 331, 4* (332, 11´ : puttānaṃ brahmasamā uttamā seṭṭhā); A I 207, 25 (ayaṃ vuccati … ariyasāvako brahmūposathaṃ upavasati ~unā saddhiṃ saṃvasati ~aṃ c’ assa ārabbha cittaṃ pasīdati; Mp II 322, 27 : ~ā vuccati sammāsambuddho tassa guṇānussaraṇavasena ayaṃ uposatho brahmūposatho nāma … sammāsambuddhena saddhiṃ saṃvasati); Sn 519 (asito tādi pavuccate sa ~ā; Pj II 427, 29 : so thutiraho sa ~ā so brāhmaṇo ti); 1065 (anusāsa ~e karuṇāyamāno vivekadhammaṃ; Pj I 592, 31 foll.: ~ā ti seṭṭhavacanaṃ etaṃ, tena bhagavantaṃ āmantayamāno āha anusāsa ~e ti); Th 182 (~uno pekkhamānassa tato cittaṃ vimucci me; Th-a II 54, 28 : sadevakassa lokassa aggabhūtattā seṭṭhaṭṭhena ~uno buddhassa bhagavato); Ap 460, 27 (bhagavā buddho … virāgo vimalo ~ā); Bv-a 11, 24 (~ā ti kho bhikkhave tathāgatass’ etaṃ adhivacanan ti); — ( iv ) a brahman (not necessarily admirable); Abh 408; 812; Pv 12:9 (~e); Thī 244 (yassa brāhmaṇa tvaṃ bhīto sadā udakaṃ otari tam eva ~e mākāsi); Ja V 196, 27* (assamassa mama ~e samīpe … bahavo tādisā rukkhā); VI 524, 3* (evam eva tuvaṃ ~e agantvā va parājito); 531, 33* (gaccha ~e yathāsukhaṃ); 569, 8* (kusalaṃ c’ eva no ~e atho ~e anāmayaṃ); — 3. brahma, mf (~ī) n. [ cf S. brāhma], associated with a brahmā, belonging to the world of brahmā gods; like Brahmā, godlike, sublime, the highest, most excellent; D I 96, 6 (~e mante adhīyitvā); M I 327, 26 (nanu tvaṃ bhikkhu passasi ~iṃ parisaṃ sannisinnan ti); S V 5, 11 (~aṃ vata bho yānaṃ; Spk III 120, 21 : ~an ti seṭṭhādhivacanaṃ etaṃ); A I 183, 7 (katamaṃ pana taṃ bho Gotama ~aṃ uccāsayanamahāsayanaṃ); 183, 28 (~o me eso tasmiṃ samaye caṅkamo hoti, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se ~ā); 243, 23 (~aṃ bhikkhave vihāraṃ tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhū viharanti); IV 76, 19 foll. (ye kho te … brahmakāyikā devā ~ena āyunā santuṭṭhā ~ena vaṇṇena ~ena sukhena … santuṭṭhā); V 76, 24 (kiṃ pana bhante ~aṃ puññan ti kappaṃ Ānanda saggamhi modatī ti); Khp 9:9 (~am etaṃ vihāram idha-m-āhu; Pj I 251, 1 : seṭṭhavihāram āhū ti); Sn 285 (~aṃ nidhiṃ apālayuṃ; Pj II 315, 6 foll.: yo cāyaṃ mettādivihāro seṭṭhattā anugāmikattā ca brahmanidhī ti vuccati); 293 (yo nesaṃ paramo āsi ~ā daḷhaparakkamo; Pj II 318, 9 : brahmasamo nāma uttamo brāhmaṇo ahosi); Ja II 14, 3* (~aṃ ca vaṇṇaṃ apacāyamāno; 14, 8´ : brahmavaṇṇaṃ seṭṭhavaṇṇaṃ pūjento); IV 452, 24* (anindito ~am upeti ṭhānaṃ); Bv 4:17 (~aṃ bhāvetvā bhāvanaṃ; Bv-a 151, 19 : ~an ti brahmavihārabhāvanaṃ bhāvetvā); Peṭ 247, 10 (cattāro vihārā dibbo ~o ariyo āneñjo, so read with Ñāṇamoli, 1964, p. 334 ); Ps II 27, 20 (ettha ~an ti seṭṭhaṃ uttamaṃ visiṭṭhaṃ); Vv-a 130, 14 (sucino suddhassa ~assa seṭṭhassa uposathasīlassa); Th-a II 274, 14 (~aṃ seṭṭhaṃ niddosaṃ mettādivihāraṃ bhāvemi); — °- apphoṭana , n. , applause by a brahmā; Dhp-a III 210, 17 (brahmattabhāvaṃ nimminitvā … ~aṃ nāma apphoṭessāmi, Be so; Ce °’-apphoṭakaṃ; Ee °’-apphoṭanaṃ; Se brahmāppoṭhanaṃ); — °’- ujugatta , °’-ujjugatta, mfn. , see sv; — °’- upapatti , °-uppatti, f. , coming into existence as a brahmā; S I 143, 10* (ayaṃ antimā vedagū ~i, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee °’-uppatti; Spk-ṭ [ Be ] I 242, 19 : sabbapacchimā brahmabhāvappatti) = Ja III 359, 20* ( Be, Ce, Ee °-patti; Se brahmupatti; 359, 25´ : pacchimakoṭippatti seṭṭhabhāvappatti, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se seṭṭhabhāvuppatti); Ja VI 204, 19´ (~ito pubbe, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se brahmuppattito); — °’- uppatti , f. , see sv brahmupapatti above; — °- kāya , m. , 1. [ cf girati 1 ?], members of a class of performers; singers or praisers; ? Mil 191, 5 (mahiyā gaṇā vattanti seyyathīdaṃ mallā atoṇā pabbatā dhammagiriyā ~ā naṭakā naccakā laṅghakā …); — °- ghaṭā , f. ( m. ) an excellent, godlike, sound; Sp 240, 9 (~aṃ nicchārento) ≠ Ps I 181, 24 ; — 2. ( mfn. ) with an excellent, god-like, voice; Ap 390, 19 (karavīkaruto nātho ~o); — °- cakka , n. , the supreme wheel of authority; M I 69, 33 (tathāgato … ~aṃ pavatteti) = S II 27, 27 (Spk II 46, 24 foll.: ettha brahman ti seṭṭhaṃ uttamaṃ, visuddhassa dhammacakkass’ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ); A II 24, 21* (~aṃ pavattayī) = It 123, 8* ; — °- cariya , n. , see sv; — °- cāri(n) , m. , °-cārinī, f. , see sv; — °- cintita , mfn. , thought out by Brahmā or brahmā gods; Vv 63:16 (ye mantaṃ parivattenti chaḷaṅgaṃ ~aṃ; Vv-a 265, 15 : mantan ti vedaṃ … ~an ti brahmehi Aṭṭhakādīhi cintitaṃ, paññācakkhunā diṭṭhaṃ) = Pv 18:13 (Pv-a 97, 29 : ~an ti brāhmaṇānaṃ atthāya brahmunā cintitaṃ kathitaṃ); — °- cera , n. , see sv brahmacariya ; — °- jāṇuka , °- jānuka , mfn. , bending one’s knee to a supreme being; Spk I 353, 3 (bhagavantaṃ namassatī ti … ~o hutvā sirasmiṃ añjaliṃ ṭhapetvā namassati; Spk-ṭ [ Be ] I 341, 10 : dakkhiṇajāṇumaṇḍalaṃ pathaviyaṃ ṭhapetvā vandamāno ~o nāma); — °- jātiyo in Ee at Sp 1364, 10 is wr for brāhmaṇajātiyo ( Be, Ce, Se so ); — °- tta , n. , the state of being Brahmā or a brahmā god; A I 28, 19 (yaṃ itthī ~aṃ kāreyya n’ etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati; Mp II 16, 3 : ~an ti mahābrahmattaṃ adhippetaṃ); Ja III 132, 5 (n’ eva sakkattaṃ na ~aṃ patthayamāno); Nidd I 73, 31 (ayaṃ diṭṭhi alaṃ nāgattāya vā … indattāya vā ~āya vā devattāya vā; Nidd-a I 203, 10 : brahmakāyikādīnaṃ aññatarabhāvāya); — °- daṇḍa , m. , 1. a serious punishment or penance; Vin II 292, 17 (āyasmā Channo ~ena aṭṭīyamāno … appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirass’ eva … tad anuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ … upasampajja vihāsi); 293, 13* (tajjito ~ena catusaccaṃ apāpuṇi); D II 154, 18 foll.
